example_incidents.summary: Rami Khaled Ahmed, a Yemeni national, has been indicted for conducting 1,500 ransomware attacks using Black Kingdom malware on Microsoft Exchange servers. The attacks targeted various U.S.-based victims, including a medical billing services company, demanding ransom payments of $10,000 in Bitcoin. Ahmed faces multiple charges, including conspiracy and intentional damage to a protected computer, with potential sentences totaling up to 15 years if convicted.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed

example_incidents.victim: medical billing services company, ski resort, school district, health clinic
example_incidents.summary: Rami Khaled Ahmed, a Yemeni national, has been indicted for conducting 1,500 ransomware attacks using Black Kingdom malware on Microsoft Exchange servers. The attacks targeted various U.S.-based victims, including a medical billing services company and a health clinic, demanding ransom payments of $10,000 in Bitcoin. Ahmed faces multiple charges, including conspiracy and intentional damage to a protected computer, with potential sentences totaling up to 15 years if convicted.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed

example_incidents.summary: Frederick Health Medical Group experienced a ransomware attack on January 27, 2025, leading to a data breach affecting nearly one million patients. The attackers gained unauthorized access to the network and copied sensitive files, prompting the health system to notify law enforcement and hire a forensic firm for investigation.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed
example_incidents.data_impact: 934,326 patients affected; sensitive personal information including names, addresses, dates of birth, Social Security numbers, driver's license numbers, medical record numbers, health insurance information, and clinical information

example_incidents.summary: The Everest ransomware gang's dark web leak site was defaced by an unknown attacker, leading to its current offline status. Everest has shifted from data theft to ransomware attacks, targeting various organizations, including healthcare entities, and has claimed numerous victims over the years.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed

example_incidents.summary: Hunters International, a ransomware group, has shifted to data extortion, launching a new operation called 'World Leaks'. In December 2023, they breached the Fred Hutch Cancer Center, threatening to leak data of over 800,000 cancer patients if a ransom was not paid.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed

example_incidents.summary: Advanced Computer Software Group Ltd was fined £3.07 million by the UK Information Commissioner's Office for a ransomware attack in 2022 that exposed the sensitive personal data of 79,404 individuals, including NHS patients. The LockBit ransomware group was responsible for the breach, which highlighted significant security shortcomings in the company's systems.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: significant outages, recovery took long with help from experts
example_incidents.data_impact: 79,404 people affected, sensitive personal data including NHS patients' information

example_incidents.summary: BayMark Health Services, North America's largest addiction treatment provider, was breached by the RansomHub ransomware gang. This incident is part of a broader trend where RansomHub has targeted multiple high-profile victims and engaged in data-theft-based extortion rather than traditional ransomware encryption.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed

example_incidents.summary: The Medusa ransomware operation has impacted over 300 organizations in critical infrastructure sectors in the United States, including the Minneapolis Public Schools. The group has claimed over 400 victims worldwide and has been active since 2021, with a significant increase in attacks observed in early 2025.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed

example_incidents.summary: Genea, a major Australian fertility services provider, was breached by the Termite ransomware gang, which claimed responsibility for stealing sensitive healthcare data. The attackers exfiltrated approximately 940.7GB of data, including personal and health information of patients, and published some of it online.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed
example_incidents.data_impact: 940.7GB of sensitive healthcare data including full names, emails, addresses, phone numbers, date of birth, emergency contacts, Medicare card numbers, medical record numbers, medical history, diagnoses and treatments, medications and prescriptions, and appointment details.

example_incidents.summary: The NailaoLocker ransomware has been used in attacks against European healthcare organizations, exploiting a vulnerability to deploy malware and encrypt files. The ransom note does not indicate that data was stolen, which is atypical for ransomware operations.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed

example_incidents.summary: The New York Blood Center experienced a ransomware attack that disrupted its operations, leading to the rescheduling of blood donation appointments. The organization is working with cybersecurity experts to restore its systems and has not confirmed whether any personal or health information was accessed or stolen during the incident.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: Some appointments had to be rescheduled and certain systems were taken offline to contain the threat.

example_incidents.summary: In February 2024, UnitedHealth's subsidiary Change Healthcare suffered a massive ransomware attack by the BlackCat gang, impacting 190 million individuals. The attack led to significant disruptions in the healthcare system, with UnitedHealth confirming a ransom payment of $22 million to receive a decryptor and prevent data leaks, which ultimately did not stop the threat actors from leaking some of the stolen data.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed
example_incidents.data_impact: 190 million individuals affected; health insurance information, medical records, billing and payment information, personal information including phone numbers, addresses, Social Security Numbers, and government ID numbers

example_incidents.summary: OneBlood confirmed that personal data was stolen in a ransomware attack that occurred from July 14 to July 29, 2024. The attack led to the encryption of virtual machines, forcing the organization to revert to manual processes and causing critical blood shortages. The investigation revealed that names and Social Security numbers were among the data copied from their network without authorization.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed

example_incidents.victim: Rhode Island's RIBridges social services platform
example_incidents.summary: The Brain Cipher ransomware gang leaked data stolen from Rhode Island's RIBridges social services platform, which manages various assistance programs. The breach, confirmed on December 10, affected around 650,000 individuals, exposing sensitive personal information. State officials are advising residents to monitor their credit and be cautious of phishing scams.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: RIBridges was shut down to remediate the threat after confirmation of the breach.
example_incidents.data_impact: Approximately 650,000 people were impacted; personal data including names, addresses, dates of birth, Social Security numbers, and certain banking information was exposed.

example_incidents.summary: Ascension, a major U.S. healthcare system, experienced a ransomware attack linked to the Black Basta group, resulting in the theft of personal and health data of approximately 5.6 million patients and employees. The breach was caused by an employee mistakenly downloading a malicious file, leading to significant operational disruptions and the need for identity theft protection services for affected individuals.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: Ascension had to take some devices offline and pause non-emergent elective procedures, tests, and appointments, diverting emergency medical services to other healthcare units.
example_incidents.data_impact: 5,599,699 individuals affected; personal and health data including medical information, payment information, insurance information, government identification information, and other personal information.
sources: Health Information Sharing and Analysis Center (Health-ISAC)

example_incidents.summary: Artivion, a manufacturer of heart surgery medical devices, experienced a ransomware attack on November 21 that disrupted its operations and forced it to take some systems offline. The attackers encrypted some of its systems and stole data from compromised systems, prompting the company to engage external advisors for incident response.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: The company is working to securely restore its systems as quickly as possible.
sources: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) filing

example_incidents.summary: Anna Jaques Hospital suffered a ransomware attack on December 25, 2023, which exposed sensitive health data for over 316,000 patients. The Money Message ransomware group publicly extorted the hospital, threatening to leak data unless their demands were met, and ultimately released all stolen data on January 26, 2024.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed
example_incidents.data_impact: 316,342 patients affected; exposed data includes demographic information, medical information, health insurance information, Social Security numbers, driver's license numbers, financial information, and other personal or health information.

example_incidents.summary: BianLian ransomware has shifted its focus to exclusively data theft extortion, abandoning file encryption tactics. The group has been active since 2022 and has listed 154 victims on its extortion portal, including notable breaches against organizations like Boston Children's Health Physicians.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed

example_incidents.summary: Evgenii Ptitsyn, a Russian national and suspected administrator of the Phobos ransomware operation, was extradited from South Korea to the United States to face cybercrime charges. The Phobos ransomware gang has been linked to breaches of over 1,000 public and private entities, extorting more than $16 million in ransom payments by encrypting victims' data and threatening to leak stolen files if payments were not made.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed

example_incidents.summary: Henry Schein disclosed a data breach following two cyberattacks in 2023 by the BlackCat Ransomware gang, revealing that over 160,000 people's personal information was stolen. The gang claimed to have stolen 35 TB of sensitive files and threatened to encrypt the network a second time if a ransom was not paid, leading to the release of some stolen data on their leak site.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: forced to take some systems offline to contain a cyberattack

example_incidents.summary: The Qilin ransomware strain, specifically the new Rust-based version Qilin.B, has been observed in attacks targeting major London hospitals. This ransomware employs advanced encryption techniques and disrupts data recovery mechanisms, posing a significant threat to affected organizations.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed

example_incidents.summary: UMC Health System in Texas experienced a ransomware attack that forced the diversion of some patients to other locations. The attack impacted its operations, leading to an IT outage and significant delays in services, particularly in radiology.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: Certain departments remain closed or can only provide services with significant delays; ongoing investigation into the incident.
example_incidents.data_impact: Sensitive medical information of hundreds of thousands could be impacted.

example_incidents.summary: The Storm-0501 ransomware group has escalated its attacks to target hybrid cloud environments, compromising various organizations including hospitals and government agencies. They deploy the Embargo ransomware after gaining access through weak credentials and exploiting vulnerabilities, often extracting sensitive data before encryption.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed

example_incidents.summary: The Centers for Medicare Medicaid Services (CMS) reported a data breach affecting over 3 million health plan beneficiaries due to the MOVEit attacks by the Cl0p ransomware group. The breach involved the exposure of sensitive health and personal information after hackers compromised the Wisconsin Physicians Service (WPS) network, which provides Medicare administrative services.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed
example_incidents.data_impact: 3,112,815 individuals affected; data types include Name, Social Security Number, Date of Birth, Mailing Address, Gender, Hospital Account Number, Dates of Service, Medicare Beneficiary Identifier, Health Insurance Claim Number

example_incidents.summary: Planned Parenthood confirmed a cyberattack affecting its IT systems, with the RansomHub group claiming responsibility and threatening to leak stolen data. The organization is investigating the incident and has reported it to federal law enforcement, while also taking proactive measures to secure its network.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: parts of its infrastructure taken offline to contain the damage
example_incidents.data_impact: 93GB of data allegedly stolen, including confidential documents

example_incidents.summary: Kootenai Health experienced a data breach affecting over 464,000 patients due to a cyberattack by the 3AM ransomware group. The attackers gained unauthorized access to the organization's systems on February 22, 2024, and leaked sensitive patient data on their darknet portal, indicating that a ransom was not paid.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: IT systems were disrupted; investigation ongoing
example_incidents.data_impact: 464,000 patients; Full names, Dates of birth, Social Security numbers (SSNs), Driver's Licenses, Government ID numbers, Medical record numbers, Medical treatment and condition information, Medical diagnoses, Health insurance information

example_incidents.summary: McLaren Health Care experienced a disruption to its IT and phone systems due to an attack linked to the INC Ransom ransomware operation. The incident resulted in the potential exposure of personal and health information of approximately 2.2 million individuals, prompting the health system to notify affected parties of the breach.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed
example_incidents.data_impact: 2.2 million people; names, Social Security numbers, health insurance and physician information, Medicare/Medicaid, prescription/medication, diagnostic results and treatment information

example_incidents.summary: In February 2024, pharmaceutical giant Cencora reportedly paid a record-breaking ransom of $75 million to the Dark Angels ransomware gang. This payment is the highest known ransom to date, surpassing the previous record of $40 million. The attack involved the encryption of corporate data and the potential theft of sensitive information, although specific details about the data impact have not been disclosed.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed

example_incidents.summary: MediSecure, an Australian prescription delivery service, experienced a ransomware attack in April 2024 that resulted in the theft of personal and health information of approximately 12.9 million individuals. The company shut down its website and phone lines to contain the breach and successfully restored the data from a backup by May 17, 2024.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: MediSecure shut down its website and phone lines; the data was restored from a server backup on May 17, 2024.
example_incidents.data_impact: 12.9 million people affected; personal and health information including names, dates of birth, addresses, contact information, individual healthcare identifiers, Medicare card numbers, prescription medication details, and concession card numbers.

example_incidents.summary: The Qilin ransomware group, linked to the Scattered Spider gang, attacked pathology services provider Synnovis in early June 2024. This incident impacted several major NHS hospitals in London, leading to the cancellation of hundreds of operations and appointments.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: forced cancellation of hundreds of operations and appointments

example_incidents.victim: All India Institute Of Medical Sciences (AIIMS)
example_incidents.summary: ChamelGang, a suspected Chinese APT, targeted the All India Institute Of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) using CatB ransomware, leading to significant disruptions in healthcare services. The attack is part of a broader trend where ransomware is employed in cyberespionage to obscure attribution and achieve financial gain alongside data theft.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: causing major disruptions in healthcare services

example_incidents.summary: Change Healthcare suffered a ransomware attack in February, leading to the theft of 6 TB of sensitive medical and personal data. The attack, conducted by the BlackCat ransomware gang, resulted in significant disruptions in the US healthcare system and a reported financial impact of $872 million.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: widespread outages in the US healthcare system, preventing doctors and pharmacies from filing claims
example_incidents.data_impact: 6 TB of data stolen, including health insurance information, health information, billing, claims and payment information, and personal information such as Social Security numbers

example_incidents.summary: Singing River Health System suffered a ransomware attack in August 2023, impacting 895,204 individuals. The Rhysida ransomware gang claimed responsibility for the attack, which resulted in operational disruptions and significant data theft, including sensitive personal and health information.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: operational disruptions at its hospitals
example_incidents.data_impact: 895,204 people affected; exposed data includes full name, date of birth, physical address, Social Security Number (SSN), medical information, health information

example_incidents.summary: The Hôpital de Cannes - Simone Veil (CHC-SV) in France experienced a ransomware attack from the LockBit 3.0 group, leading to significant operational disruptions. The hospital announced it would not pay the ransom and has reported the incident to authorities while working to restore its systems.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: severe operational disruption, all computers taken offline, non-emergency procedures and appointments rescheduled

example_incidents.summary: Synlab Italia suspended all medical diagnostic and testing services following a ransomware attack that forced its IT systems offline. The attack occurred in the early hours of April 18, leading to a complete shutdown of the corporate infrastructure to limit damage. There are concerns that some sensitive medical data may have been exposed to the attackers.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: All laboratory analysis and sample collection services have been suspended until further notice. The company has started gradually reactivating some services, but no specific recovery timeline was provided.

example_incidents.victim: Group Health Cooperative of South Central Wisconsin (GHC-SCW)
example_incidents.summary: GHC-SCW experienced a ransomware attack in January 2024, where a gang stole personal and medical data of over 533,000 individuals. Although the attackers did not encrypt the devices, they claimed responsibility for the breach and the stolen data included sensitive health information. GHC-SCW has since implemented security measures to prevent future incidents.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: several systems temporarily unavailable; systems secured and brought back online after isolation
example_incidents.data_impact: 533,809 individuals; personal and medical information including names, addresses, telephone numbers, e-mail addresses, dates of birth and/or deaths, social security numbers, member numbers, and Medicare and/or Medicaid numbers

example_incidents.summary: The INC Ransom extortion gang is threatening to leak 3TB of stolen data from NHS Dumfries and Galloway unless a ransom is paid. The data includes sensitive medical information about patients and staff, and the attack has been confirmed to have compromised the organization's IT systems. The Scottish Government is working with various agencies to assess the impact of the breach.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed

example_incidents.summary: The ALPHV/BlackCat ransomware gang allegedly scammed an affiliate out of a $22 million ransom paid by Optum for the Change Healthcare platform. The affiliate claims to possess 4TB of critical data and has threatened to leak it if their demands are not met. The gang has since shut down its servers, leading to speculation about an exit scam.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed
example_incidents.data_impact: 4TB of critical data from Optum, affecting tens of insurance companies and other providers

example_incidents.summary: Lurie Children's Hospital in Chicago was attacked by the Rhysida ransomware gang, which claims to have stolen 600 GB of sensitive data. The hospital's IT systems were taken offline, leading to postponed medical care and significant operational disruptions. The gang is demanding $3.6 million for the stolen data, threatening to leak it if not paid within a week.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: Ongoing efforts to restore IT systems; service disruptions still impact operational segments.
example_incidents.data_impact: 600 GB of sensitive medical data; records of over 200,000 children affected.

example_incidents.summary: The FBI, CISA, and HHS warned U.S. healthcare organizations of targeted BlackCat ransomware attacks, particularly affecting the healthcare sector. The advisory follows a series of breaches linked to the BlackCat gang, which has been active since late 2021 and has extorted over $300 million from victims. The gang's recent activities have led to significant disruptions in healthcare services, including an ongoing outage at Change Healthcare.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: ongoing outage impacting Change Healthcare

example_incidents.summary: A ransomware attack targeted the Hipocrate Information System used by 100 hospitals in Romania, leading to the encryption of data and systems going offline. The attackers demanded a ransom of 3.5 BTC, while cybersecurity experts are investigating the incident and assessing recovery options.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: Systems taken offline; hospitals reverted to paper records due to shutdown of servers and internet.
example_incidents.data_impact: 25 hospitals confirmed data encrypted; personal and medical data status unclear.

example_incidents.summary: Capital Health, a healthcare service provider, was attacked by the LockBit ransomware gang, which claimed to have stolen sensitive medical data and threatened to leak it if ransom demands were not met. The organization experienced an IT systems outage due to the attack but has since restored operations and is investigating the extent of the data theft.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: The organization experienced an IT systems outage following the cyberattack, impacting operations for at least a week. All systems have been restored and operations have returned to normal.
example_incidents.data_impact: 7 terabytes of sensitive medical data, over 10 million files

example_incidents.victim: Carthage Area Hospital and Claxton-Hepburn Medical Center
example_incidents.summary: Carthage Area Hospital and Claxton-Hepburn Medical Center were attacked by the LockBit ransomware gang in September 2023, leading to a disruption in services. The hospitals are now seeking a court order to retrieve stolen data stored on a cloud service provider's servers.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed

example_incidents.summary: The Lockbit ransomware attack on December 24, 2023, disrupted emergency care at three hospitals operated by KHO in Germany. While patient treatment continues, emergency services are unavailable, leading to potential delays for those needing urgent medical attention.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: Emergency care is unavailable; patient treatment continues with some technical restrictions.

example_incidents.summary: Integris Health, Oklahoma's largest not-for-profit health network, suffered a cyberattack that led to the theft of patient data. Patients received extortion emails claiming their data was stolen and would be sold unless a ransom was paid. The investigation revealed unauthorized access to certain files on November 28, 2023.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed
example_incidents.data_impact: over 2 million patients; includes Social Security Numbers, dates of birth, addresses, phone numbers, insurance information, and employer information

example_incidents.summary: ESO Solutions, a healthcare software provider, experienced a ransomware attack that compromised data belonging to 2.7 million patients. The attack involved data exfiltration and encryption of company systems, with sensitive personal data accessed from one machine. The incident was reported to the FBI and state authorities, and impacted customers were notified.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed
example_incidents.data_impact: 2.7 million patients; Full name, Dates of birth, Phone number, Patient account/medical record number, Injury type and date, Diagnosis information, Treatment type and date, Procedure information, Social Security Number (SSN)

example_incidents.summary: The Hunters International ransomware gang attacked the Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center, threatening to leak sensitive data of over 800,000 patients. The organization took immediate action by quarantining servers and notifying law enforcement, while the attackers sent personalized extortion emails to patients, demanding payment to prevent data disclosure.
example_incidents.ransom_demanded_or_paid: $50 to prevent data from being sold
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: The health organization quarantined the impacted servers and took its clinical network offline to prevent the spread of the threat.
example_incidents.data_impact: over 800,000 patients' names, Social Security numbers, phone numbers, medical history, lab results, and insurance history

example_incidents.summary: Norton Healthcare confirmed a ransomware attack in May 2023 that exposed personal information of approximately 2.5 million individuals, including patients and employees. The attack was claimed by the BlackCat/ALPHV gang, who alleged to have stolen 4.7TB of data and leaked sensitive files as proof of the breach.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed
example_incidents.data_impact: 2.5 million individuals; names, contact information, Social Security Numbers, dates of birth, health information, insurance information, medical identification numbers, financial account numbers, driver's licenses, digital signatures

example_incidents.summary: Ardent Health Services experienced a ransomware attack that disrupted emergency services across six states. The organization took its network offline and is currently investigating the extent of the attack while working to restore access to its systems.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: Ardent took its entire network offline and is working to restore encrypted systems; no definitive timeline for restoration provided.

example_incidents.summary: Welltok experienced a data breach that exposed the personal data of nearly 8.5 million patients in the U.S. due to a hack of their MOVEit Transfer server. The breach, attributed to the Clop ransomware gang, involved the theft of sensitive patient information, including Social Security Numbers and health insurance details.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed
example_incidents.data_impact: 8,493,379 individuals; full names, email addresses, physical addresses, telephone numbers, Social Security Numbers, Medicare/Medicaid ID numbers, Health Insurance information

example_incidents.summary: The FBI and CISA issued a warning about the Rhysida ransomware gang, which has been targeting various sectors including healthcare, education, and manufacturing since its emergence in May 2023. The gang is known for exploiting vulnerabilities and using phishing attacks to gain access to networks, leading to opportunistic ransomware attacks.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed

example_incidents.summary: MCNA Dental, one of the largest dental insurance companies in the U.S., suffered a massive ransomware attack that exposed the personal data of up to 8.9 million patients. The incident highlights the vulnerability of healthcare organizations to cybercriminals and the serious implications for patient care.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed
example_incidents.data_impact: 8.9 million patients; names, addresses, Social Security numbers, and more
sources: IBM's 2023 Cost of a Breach Report

example_incidents.summary: TransForm, a shared service provider for multiple hospitals in Ontario, was hit by a ransomware attack that compromised a database containing information on 5.6 million patient visits. The attackers, identified as the DAIXIN Team, exfiltrated data and threatened to leak it, but TransForm confirmed they would not pay the ransom.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: Operational disruptions caused by the attack forced healthcare providers to reschedule appointments and redirect non-emergency cases to other clinics.
example_incidents.data_impact: Data on 5.6 million patient visits corresponding to 267,000 unique patients; data on 1,446 individuals from Chatham-Kent Health Alliance; data on 352 employees from Erie Shores HealthCare; limited patient data from Windsor Regional Hospital; some patient data from Hôpital-Dieu Grace Healthcare.

example_incidents.summary: The Better Outcomes Registry Network (BORN) in Ontario experienced a data breach due to the Clop ransomware's MOVEit hacking spree, affecting approximately 3.4 million individuals. The breach involved the theft of sensitive information related to newborns and pregnancy care patients, with BORN taking steps to contain the threat and monitor for any misuse of the data.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: BORN engaged with cybersecurity experts to isolate the impacted servers and contain the threat, which allowed its operations to continue.
example_incidents.data_impact: 3.4 million people affected; exposed data includes full name, home address, postal code, date of birth, health card number, and additional data such as dates of service/care, lab test results, pregnancy risk factors, type of birth, procedures, pregnancy and birth outcomes.

example_incidents.summary: The Ragnar Locker ransomware gang claimed responsibility for an attack on Israel's Mayanei Hayeshua hospital, threatening to leak 1 TB of data allegedly stolen during the cyberattack. This incident highlights the ongoing threat of ransomware operations targeting healthcare institutions.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed

example_incidents.summary: Mom's Meals, a medical meal delivery service, experienced a ransomware attack that compromised the personal information of 1.2 million customers and employees. The breach was identified on February 22, 2023, after suspicious activity was detected on their networks, revealing that files had been encrypted and sensitive data accessed by hackers.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed
example_incidents.data_impact: 1,237,681 people; Date of birth, Driver's license, State identification number, Financial account information, Payment card information, Medical record number, Medicare and Medicaid identification, Health information, Treatment information, Diagnosis code, Meal category and cost, Health insurance information, Patient ID number, Social Security Numbers (for 1% of the exposed people)

example_incidents.summary: The Rhysida ransomware gang claimed responsibility for a cyberattack on Prospect Medical Holdings, threatening to sell stolen data including 500,000 social security numbers and patient records. The attack, which occurred on August 3rd, forced hospitals to revert to paper records as they shut down their IT networks to contain the breach.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: Hospitals shut down IT networks, forced to use paper charts; systems are now up and running but still restoring patient records.
example_incidents.data_impact: 500,000 social security numbers, passports, driver's licenses, corporate documents, and patient's medical information.

example_incidents.summary: The Rhysida ransomware group has targeted Prospect Medical Group, impacting 17 hospitals and 166 clinics across the United States. The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services has identified Rhysida as a significant threat to the healthcare sector following these attacks.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed

example_incidents.summary: The Comprehensive Medical Care Program (PAMI) in Argentina suffered a ransomware cyberattack that encrypted files and demanded a ransom. Official sources confirmed the attack and stated that they are investigating the source of the intrusion, while assuring that operations such as shifts and medicine purchases continued normally.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: the site was taken down but was mitigated

example_incidents.summary: Eisai, a pharmaceutical company, disclosed that it suffered a ransomware incident that impacted its operations, admitting that attackers encrypted some of its servers. The attack was attributed to the Clop ransomware gang, which has been exploiting vulnerabilities in the MOVEit Transfer platform.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed
sources: The Week in Ransomware - June 9th 2023 - It’s Clop... Again!

example_incidents.summary: Harvard Pilgrim Health Care disclosed that a ransomware attack in April 2023 impacted over 2.5 million individuals. The threat actors not only encrypted data but also stole sensitive information from compromised systems.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed
sources: The Week in Ransomware - June 2nd 2023 - Whodunit?

example_incidents.victim: Managed Care of North America (MCNA) Dental
example_incidents.summary: MCNA Dental experienced a ransomware attack that compromised the personal data of approximately 8.9 million patients. The LockBit ransomware gang claimed responsibility for the attack, threatening to publish sensitive information unless a ransom of $10 million was paid. Following the breach, MCNA has implemented measures to enhance security and has offered identity theft protection to affected individuals.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: MCNA has taken all appropriate steps to remediate the situation and enhance the security of its systems.
example_incidents.data_impact: 8,923,662 people; personal data including full name, address, date of birth, phone number, email, Social Security number, driver's license number, government-issued ID number, health insurance information, and dental care records.

example_incidents.summary: Mikhail Pavlovich Matveev, a Russian citizen, has been charged for his involvement in multiple ransomware operations targeting U.S. critical infrastructure, including healthcare and law enforcement organizations. Notably, in May 2022, he and the Hive ransomware gang encrypted the systems of a nonprofit behavioral healthcare organization in New Jersey.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed
sources: Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC)

example_incidents.summary: PharMerica experienced a significant data breach affecting over 5.8 million patients, with hackers stealing sensitive medical data. The Money Message ransomware gang claimed responsibility for the attack, which occurred on March 12, 2023, and published the stolen data on their extortion site on April 9, 2023.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed
example_incidents.data_impact: 5,815,591 individuals affected; full names, addresses, dates of birth, social security numbers, medications, health insurance information

example_incidents.summary: Brightline, a pediatric mental health provider, experienced a data breach affecting 783,606 patients due to a ransomware attack by the Clop gang, which exploited a zero-day vulnerability in their secure file-sharing platform. The stolen data included sensitive personal health information, prompting Brightline to implement immediate security measures and offer affected individuals identity theft protection services.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: Fortra deactivated the unauthorized user's credentials, turned off the service, and rebuilt their version to eliminate the vulnerability.
example_incidents.data_impact: 783,606 individuals affected; data types include full names, physical addresses, dates of birth, member identification numbers, date of health plan coverage, and employer names.

example_incidents.summary: The Hospital Cl nic de Barcelona suffered a ransomware attack on March 7th, 2023, which severely disrupted its healthcare services. The attack targeted the institution's virtual machines, leading to significant operational challenges.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: severely disrupting its healthcare services

example_incidents.victim: Regal Medical Group, Lakeside Medical Organization, ADOC Medical Group, Greater Covina Medical
example_incidents.summary: A ransomware attack on multiple medical groups in the Heritage Provider Network in California exposed sensitive information of 3.3 million patients. The attack occurred on December 1, 2022, leading to the compromise of various personal and medical data. The affected organizations have since implemented additional security measures to prevent future incidents.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: System restoration process was initiated after the attack was discovered.
example_incidents.data_impact: 3,300,638 patients; Full name, Social Security Number (SSN), Date of birth, Address, Medical diagnosis and treatment, Laboratory test results, Prescription data, Radiology reports, Health plan member number, Phone number
sources: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services breach portal

example_incidents.summary: Multiple medical groups in the Heritage Provider Network in California suffered a ransomware attack, exposing sensitive patient information of over 3.3 million patients. The attack occurred on December 1, 2022, leading to a significant data breach that included various personal and medical details.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: System restoration process initiated after malware infection was confirmed.
example_incidents.data_impact: 3,300,638 patients; Full name, Social Security Number (SSN), Date of birth, Address, Medical diagnosis and treatment, Laboratory test results, Prescription data, Radiology reports, Health plan member number, Phone number.
sources: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services breach portal

example_incidents.summary: AmerisourceBergen confirmed a security breach involving the Lorenz ransomware gang, which leaked allegedly stolen data from one of its subsidiaries. The company is investigating whether sensitive data was compromised and has contained the intrusion.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed

example_incidents.summary: Tallahassee Memorial HealthCare (TMH) suffered a cyberattack that led to the suspension of non-emergency procedures and the taking offline of its IT systems. The attack occurred on February 2nd, 2023, and is part of a larger trend of ransomware attacks targeting healthcare facilities.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: IT systems taken offline and non-emergency procedures suspended

example_incidents.summary: The LockBit ransomware gang attacked the SickKids children's hospital, leading to operational delays. They later provided a free decryptor after claiming that a rogue affiliate violated their policies by targeting the healthcare organization.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: delays in receiving lab and imaging results and longer wait times for patients

example_incidents.summary: The LockBit ransomware gang attacked SickKids on December 18th, impacting internal systems and causing delays in patient care. Following the incident, the gang apologized and provided a free decryptor, stating that the attack violated their policies against targeting medical institutions.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: SickKids announced that it had restored 50% of its priority systems by December 29th, including those causing diagnostic or treatment delays.

example_incidents.summary: The Lake Charles Memorial Health System experienced a ransomware attack that impacted nearly 270,000 patients. Hackers gained unauthorized access to the network, stole sensitive files, and the Hive ransomware group later claimed responsibility for the attack, listing LCMHS on their data leak site after failed ransom negotiations.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed
example_incidents.data_impact: 269,752 individuals affected; includes full names, physical addresses, dates of birth, medical records, patient identification numbers, health insurance information, payment information, limited clinical information, and Social Security numbers (in some cases)

example_incidents.summary: The Andr-Mignot teaching hospital in Paris experienced a ransomware attack that led to the shutdown of its phone and computer systems. This incident caused significant disruption, requiring the rerouting of some patients to other hospitals.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: significant disruption, causing some patients to be rerouted to other hospitals

example_incidents.summary: CommonSpirit Health experienced a ransomware attack in October 2022, which exposed the personal data of 623,774 patients. The organization confirmed that unauthorized access occurred between September 16 and October 3, 2022, and that certain files containing personal information were accessed by the threat actors.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed
example_incidents.data_impact: 623,774 patients; Full name, address, phone number(s), date of birth, unique ID
sources: U.S. Department of Health breach portal

example_incidents.summary: Keralty, a major healthcare provider in Colombia, suffered a ransomware attack by the RansomHouse group, severely disrupting its operations and websites. The attack resulted in significant delays in patient care, with reports of patients waiting for over twelve hours for medical attention.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: Patients have had to wait upwards of twelve hours to receive care, with reports of people fainting due to the lack of medical attention.

example_incidents.summary: The FBI reported that the Hive ransomware gang has extorted approximately $100 million from over 1,300 victims since June 2021. The advisory highlights that Hive actors threaten to reinfect networks of organizations that do not pay the ransom, targeting various industries, particularly Healthcare and Public Health entities.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed
sources: Department of Health and Human Services (HHS)

example_incidents.summary: Medibank, a major Australian health insurer, reported a data breach where the REvil ransomware group leaked sensitive customer information. The leaked data includes personal and health information of millions of customers, and Medibank has stated it will not pay any ransom to the attackers.
example_incidents.ransom_demanded_or_paid: no ransom payment will be made
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed
example_incidents.data_impact: approximately 9.7 million current and former customers' personal data including names, addresses, dates of birth, phone numbers, email addresses, Medicare numbers, and some health claims data

example_incidents.summary: A ransomware gang, believed to be a relaunch of REvil and tracked as BlogXX, has threatened to leak stolen data from Medibank, one of Australia's largest health insurers. Medibank confirmed that sensitive information belonging to millions of customers was accessed, including personal details and health claims data, but stated it would not pay the ransom demanded by the attackers.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed
example_incidents.data_impact: Approximately 9.7 million current and former customers' names, dates of birth, addresses, phone numbers, email addresses, Medicare numbers, passport numbers, visa details, health claims data for roughly 480,000 customers, health provider details.

example_incidents.summary: Australian Clinical Labs disclosed a ransomware attack that exposed sensitive patient data, including Medicare numbers and credit card information, affecting 223,000 individuals. The Quantum ransomware group claimed responsibility and leaked 86GB of data on the dark web, prompting ACL to notify impacted clients and offer credit monitoring services.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed
example_incidents.data_impact: 223,000 people affected; 128,608 Medicare numbers, 28,286 credit card numbers, 17,539 individual medical and health records

example_incidents.victim: U.S. Healthcare and Public Health sector
example_incidents.summary: The Daixin Team is a ransomware and data extortion group actively targeting the U.S. Healthcare and Public Health sector. They have been linked to multiple incidents involving the encryption of healthcare systems and the theft of sensitive patient information, using double extortion tactics to pressure victims into paying ransoms.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed
example_incidents.data_impact: patient health information (PHI) and personal identifiable information (PII)
sources: Department of Health and Human Services (HHS)

example_incidents.summary: CommonSpirit confirmed that they suffered a ransomware attack, prompting immediate protective measures and an investigation. They engaged cybersecurity specialists and notified law enforcement to assist in the response process.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: Our facilities are following existing protocols for system outages, which includes taking certain systems offline, such as electronic health records.
sources: The Week in Ransomware - October 14th 2022 - Bitcoin Trickery

example_incidents.summary: The Consorci Sanitari Integral (CSI) suffered a ransomware attack affecting all its healthcare centers in Barcelona and Baix Llobregat. Health workers do not have access to patient information or procedures through computers, limiting consultations to emergencies only.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: Health activity and patient care are maintained in what does not require computer services, with consultations practically only for emergencies.

example_incidents.summary: The Consorci Sanitari Integral (CSI) suffered a ransomware attack affecting all its healthcare centers in Barcelona and Baix Llobregat. This incident is the second ransomware attack on the organization in two years, severely limiting access to patient information and procedures for health workers.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: Health activity and patient care are maintained in what does not require computer services, with consultations practically only for emergencies.

example_incidents.summary: The Bl00dy Ransomware Gang has utilized a leaked LockBit 3.0 ransomware builder in an attack on a Ukrainian entity. This gang, which began operating around May 2022, targets networks, steals corporate data, and encrypts devices, using a Telegram channel for extortion instead of a Tor data leak site.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed

example_incidents.summary: Empress EMS, a New York-based emergency response and ambulance service provider, disclosed a data breach that exposed customer information following a ransomware attack. The incident was attributed to the LockBit ransomware operation.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed

example_incidents.summary: The Center Hospitalier Sud Francilien (CHSF) in France was hit by a ransomware attack that demanded a ransom of $10 million. The attack rendered the hospital's business software and patient information systems inaccessible, leading to the referral of patients to other medical centers and postponement of surgeries.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: The hospital has referred patients to other establishments and postponed surgeries due to the cyberattack, with ongoing IT system outages affecting operations.

example_incidents.summary: A ransomware attack on the managed service provider Advanced disrupted emergency services for the UK's National Health Service (NHS). The attack began on August 4, 2023, and has affected several hundred customers using various software solutions. Full recovery is anticipated to take a month as Advanced works to restore services securely.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: Full service recovery may take a month; reconnecting to environments expected to take at least three to four weeks for some customers.

example_incidents.victim: Kansas hospital and other American health care providers
example_incidents.summary: The FBI recovered approximately $500,000 paid by American healthcare providers to the Maui ransomware gang, which targets healthcare organizations. A Kansas hospital paid about $100,000 in May 2021 to restore its IT network after a ransomware attack, and another medical provider in Colorado paid $120,000 shortly thereafter. The quick reporting of these incidents allowed law enforcement to track and seize the ransom payments.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed

example_incidents.summary: Professional Finance Company Inc. (PFC) experienced a ransomware attack in late February that led to a data breach. The incident affected over 600 healthcare organizations, highlighting the significant impact of ransomware on the healthcare sector.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed

example_incidents.summary: Moises Luis Zagala Gonzalez, a 55-year-old cardiologist, allegedly created and rented Jigsaw and Thanos ransomware to cybercriminals, profiting from a global ransomware ecosystem. He provided support and training to attackers on how to use the ransomware tools, which included features like a 'Doomsday' counter that deletes files until a ransom is paid.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed
sources: US Department of Justice press release

example_incidents.summary: The US Department of State is offering up to $15 million for information on the Conti ransomware gang, which has targeted over 1,000 victims and caused payouts exceeding $150 million. The Conti group is linked to various cybercrime activities and has been responsible for numerous ransomware incidents, including attacks on healthcare organizations.
example_incidents.downtime_and_recovery: not publicly disclosed

aggregate_stats.metric: Healthcare ransom demand and payment trend, 2025
aggregate_stats.value: Average ransom demand fell 91% year-over-year to $343K (from $4M in 2024); average ransom paid fell to $150K (from $1.47M) - lowest of any sector surveyed; only 36% of healthcare providers paid (down from 61% in 2022)
aggregate_stats.source: Sophos State of Ransomware in Healthcare 2025

aggregate_stats.metric: Healthcare mean ransomware recovery cost (excluding ransom), 2025
aggregate_stats.value: $1.02 million, down 60% from $2.57 million in 2024
aggregate_stats.source: Sophos State of Ransomware in Healthcare 2025

aggregate_stats.metric: Data-encryption rate in healthcare ransomware incidents, 2025
aggregate_stats.value: 34% of attacks resulted in data encryption - a 5-year low; attacks stopped before encryption at a 5-year high
aggregate_stats.source: Sophos State of Ransomware in Healthcare 2025

aggregate_stats.metric: Confirmed ransomware attacks on healthcare providers, 2024 vs 2025
aggregate_stats.value: 2024: 181 confirmed attacks on providers, ~25.6 million records affected, avg demand $5.7M, avg paid $900K. 2025: 445 attacks on hospitals/clinics/direct-care providers plus 191 on healthcare businesses (vendors/billing/pharma), avg demand ~$600K
aggregate_stats.source: Comparitech Healthcare Ransomware Roundup 2025

aggregate_stats.metric: Median ransom paid by healthcare victims, 2025
aggregate_stats.value: ~$150,000 - among the lowest of any industry tracked
aggregate_stats.source: Coveware Quarterly Ransomware Report (via industry press coverage)

aggregate_stats.metric: Share of healthcare breaches involving ransomware
aggregate_stats.value: 48% of all healthcare breaches involved ransomware in the 2026 DBIR reporting period (Nov 2024-Oct 2025), up from 44% the prior year
aggregate_stats.source: Verizon 2026 Data Breach Investigations Report, Healthcare Snapshot

aggregate_stats.metric: Healthcare share of all ransomware attacks, Q2 2025
aggregate_stats.value: 13.7% of ransomware attacks in Q2 2025 targeted healthcare, among the most-targeted sectors
aggregate_stats.source: Coveware Q2 2025 Ransomware Report (via Veeam press release)
